texts.label: text
texts.orig: The EU NIS2 directive has to be transposed by EU member states into national law until October 17, 2024. State of completion of NIS2 law differs significantly between EU member states. Some countries have final drafts or enacted law, others have scant public information.
texts.text: The EU NIS2 directive has to be transposed by EU member states into national law until October 17, 2024. State of completion of NIS2 law differs significantly between EU member states. Some countries have final drafts or enacted law, others have scant public information.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Implementations of NIS2 diverge between member states in many details - sectors and entities are defined differently, obligations are interpreted in multiple ways. Audit obligations will sometimes be fulfilled by operators, sometimes by authorities, sometimes not at all.
texts.text: Implementations of NIS2 diverge between member states in many details - sectors and entities are defined differently, obligations are interpreted in multiple ways. Audit obligations will sometimes be fulfilled by operators, sometimes by authorities, sometimes not at all.
